_about: What the Pinterest learning loop knows (scripts/pins-learn.mjs writes it monthly; scripts/pins-plan.mjs reads it). Owner decision 2026-09-24: learn only from long-term results, outbound clicks and saves of Pins at least 180 days old. weights: feature -> multiplier (0.5-2, shrunk toward 1 for small samples). winners: the top 10% at day 180, the only moments that may come back (fresh image, after 6 months, at most 10% of slots). compositionNotes: added to the createSketch guidance per kind of page; seeded from the 2026-09-23 audit until enough tagged Pins reach day 180. rejects: pages the daily review rejected (pins-plan --reject), 2 rejects = the item variant is skipped. snapshots: per Pin, lifetime clicks/saves/impressions at day 180 and 365.

compositionNotes.kids: Friendly faces (people or animals), big, clear and happy or tender, close enough to connect with, doing the moment. Fill the whole page with the story's own setting (landscape, plants, animals, buildings) in bold closed shapes. No big empty sky or sea, no abstract swirls, no tiny crowded details.
compositionNotes.adult: Fill the whole page with rich, ornate detail to color: panels, lush garden or landscape, rays of light, an ornate border. A recognizable, peaceful or majestic scene. Avoid a lone static figure, suffering, bare backgrounds and nudity.
compositionNotes.verse: Large, bold outline letters that fill the page, on a scroll or banner, with an ornate border and cheerful motifs (stars, hearts, clouds, rays). No thin lettering floating in wide empty space.

traitNotes.all: Resonates: layout scroll, density dense. Falls flat: faces awe, faces worried, feel solemn, setting sparse, density sparse, density balanced.
traitNotes.kids: Falls flat: lines medium, scale medium, characters 0, viewpoint wide.
traitNotes.adult: Resonates: feel peaceful, characters 0, faces none, viewpoint wide, composition diagonal, animals yes, density dense. Falls flat: density balanced, feel solemn, characters 1, faces awe.
traitNotes.verse: Resonates: density dense, composition framed, layout scroll, lines medium.

lessons._about: The visual study (monthly): the most and least resonant Pins of each kind side by side, what the winners share and the losers lack. Resonance = clicks + saves per 1,000 impressions, ranked within the board, so topic luck and distribution luck are left out. First study 2026-09-24 on the Nov-Dec 2025 Pins (146 at 180+ days).

kids.winners: Top 6 (9-12 per 1k): Adam breathing in life (x2), Esther before the king, Eden fruit trees, Adam and Eve behind leaves, Eden river. A big, friendly, calm or smiling face (usually one or two people) in the middle, and the garden fills every corner with bold shapes.
kids.losers: Bottom 6 (0.6-2 per 1k): dry land and seas (x2), wind-swirl hills, a small ark with tiny animals on empty waves, Eve half-hidden in leaves, a Teen stained-glass scene. No person or no readable face, large empty areas, thin or abstract lines, the subject too small.

adult.winners: Top 6 (15-19 per 1k): stained-glass wise men under the star, stained-glass creation trees and sea, the Psalm 23 meadow with sheep, Eden trees, Jesus teaching. Every inch patterned, ornate frames, peaceful or majestic mood, the scene readable at a glance.
adult.losers: Bottom 6 (3-5 per 1k): the crucifixion, a torch and firepot (Genesis 15:17), Esther Doodles, Peter at the empty tomb, John the Baptist standing alone, a nude Adam and Eve. Suffering, abstract objects, lone static figures, half-empty backgrounds, nudity.

verse.winners: Top 6 (16-27 per 1k): bold bubbly letters (Playful) filling a scroll or the page, cheerful stars, hearts and clouds, an ornate frame; famous verses (Romans 8:28, Joshua 1:9, 1 John 4:8, John 10:30).
verse.losers: Bottom 6 (0-10 per 1k): thin script or brush letters with lots of white space, fragments or odd KJV wording ("saying, The Lord risen indeed", "Let all your things be done with charity"), little decoration.

lessons.balance: Luck vs lessons: reach (clicks + saves) is partly a lottery (topic, season, distribution), so it only steers WHAT to post, with 20% of slots exploring. The image itself is judged by resonance, for Pins shown 300+ times, ranked within their board, and a trait needs 8+ Pins before it counts (hunch / moderate / strong). Winners and losers weigh the same: each trait moves up with the Pins above the board median and down with those below.
